title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
Paper signals only. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record. The live paper record is a running account of engine state: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing now. One trade does not say anything about a strategy, and a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise.

## Open positions, closed trades, and the first live signal

Paper means no real orders are placed anywhere in this record. The closed-trade figures are measurements from that paper record, not claims about future performance. htf-rsi-v007 has 0 positions open on paper and 4 closed trades so far, with average null net per trade. trend-daily-v005 has 0 positions open on paper and 6 closed trades so far, with average -13.22% net per trade. trend-daily-v006 has 0 positions open on paper and 7 closed trades so far, with average -13.34% net per trade. The first live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. ATOM exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is -17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. A NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since. Because the record is paper, these outcomes describe what the engines' rules would have produced, not money gained or lost.

## Market filter and nearest 20-day breakouts

trend-daily-v005 has the Bitcoin market filter off. trend-daily-v006 has the Bitcoin market filter off. The nearest 20-day breakout distances are measurements of how far each symbol is below its high. For trend-daily-v005, ZECUSDT is 4.65% below its high, UNIUSDT is 5.26% below its high, and BNBUSDT is 8.38% below its high. For trend-daily-v006, the same distances are listed: ZECUSDT is 4.65% below its high, UNIUSDT is 5.26% below its high, and BNBUSDT is 8.38% below its high. These are current distance measurements from the running record, not signals to act on.

## Live starts, testing expectation, and where to check

trend-daily-v005 counts its live record from 1 October 2026. trend-daily-v006 counts its live record from 9 October 2026. The first live signal came after those starts: ATOM at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. In testing, the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise. The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel. This live snapshot was read at 2026-11-08T14:46:51.097Z, and the record updates continuously.
